claim.claim: YouTube advertising revenues for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 grew by more than 10% year over year.

verdict.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: YouTube ads revenues increased $1.3 billion and $2.2 billion from the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 to the three and six months ended June 30, 2026.

verdict.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that YouTube advertising revenues for Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) grew by more than 10% year over year.

From evidence E4, the revenue table shows:
- YouTube ads Q2 2025 (three months ended June 30, 2025): $9,796 million
- YouTube ads Q2 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026): $11,055 million

The year-over-year growth calculation:
($11,055 - $9,796) / $9,796 = $1,259 / $9,796 = 0.1286 or 12.86%

This is confirmed by E1 which states "YouTube ads revenues increased $1.3 billion...from the three...months ended June 30, 2025 to the three...months ended June 30, 2026" (the $1.3 billion rounds from the actual $1,259 million increase).

Since 12.86% > 10%, the claim is supported by the evidence.
